decisions.reason: The modeling-quality standard does not change the existing reference basis, provisional-input policy, or assumption-disclosure rules.
The source establishes a general modeling-quality standard but does not change the AUD currency or 2031 price base.
Government review was already recorded as the intended use, and the source does not specifically change the existing professional, clear, and strongly presented presentation criteria.
The quality instruction does not alter the required demonstration that availability-style payments are necessary for viability and bankability.
The source does not change the identified revenue streams or the requirement to model each stream separately.
The general quality standard does not change the status or method of the financing assumptions.
The source does not change the OPEX input basis, provisional status, or assumption-flagging requirement.
The source does not change the CAPEX input status, midpoint assumption basis, or site typologies.
The modeling-quality standard does not change the required debt schedule or DSCR output.
The source does not change Cases F and G, the availability-payment mechanism, or the scenario-comparison requirement.
The general quality instruction does not add, remove, or change any sensitivity-analysis dimension.
The source does not change the site count, site typologies, or treatment of missing site-level details.
